Hi team,

Social content calendar has been updated for the week of Jan 5-9, 2026 (batch ref: SCH-W02-2026).

Scheduled posts:
- LinkedIn (Jan 5): 2025 Year in Review blog post
- Twitter (Jan 6): Product update announcement

Best,
Content Team"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_old_social_policy", "from_": "vp-marketing@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Social Media Strategy Shift - Q4", "date": "2025-10-15T00:00:00Z", "is_read": true}

日期：2025-10-15T00:00:00Z
主题：Social Media Strategy Shift - Q4
Team,

Effective immediately, all content should be posted to ALL platforms. No more platform-specific filtering. Also, prioritize team spotlights over blog posts -- we need more human content.

Additionally, case studies should ONLY go on the website, never on social media. They're too long-form.

Thanks,
VP Marketing"}
